question: A and B can finish a work in 20 days while B and C can do it in 36 days. A started the work, worked for 5 days, then B worked for 10 days and the remaining work was finished by C in 15 days. In how many days could C alone have finished the whole work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(20, 36) = 180 units.

Efficiency of (A + B) = 180 ÷ 20 = 9 units/day | (B + C) = 180 ÷ 36 = 5 units/day.

Work split: 5A + 10B + 15C = 180 ⇒ 5(A + B) + 5(B + C) + 10C = 180

⇒ 5 × 9 + 5 × 5 + 10C = 180 ⇒ 70 + 10C = 180 ⇒ C = 11 units/day.

Time for C alone = 180 ÷ 11 = 16 ⁴/₁₁ days.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 ⁴/₁₁ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (A + B) = 20 days

Time taken by (B + C) = 36 days

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work completed by A in 5 days, B in 10 days, and C in 15 days = Total Work

⇒ 5A + 10B + 15C = 180

⇒ 5A + 5B + 5B + 5C + 10C = 180

⇒ 5(A + B) + 5(B + C) + 10C = 180

⇒ 5 × 9 + 5 × 5 + 10C = 180

⇒ 45 + 25 + 10C = 180

⇒ 70 + 10C = 180

⇒ 10C = 180 − 70

⇒ 10C = 110

⇒ C = 11 units/day

⇒ Time taken by C alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of C

⇒ Time = 180 ÷ 11

⇒ Time = 16 ⁴/₁₁ days

**∴ The correct answer is 16 ⁴/₁₁ days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work and Efficiency

Total Work is calculated as the LCM of the given time periods. Efficiency is the work done per day and is inversely proportional to the time taken.

Work Split Technique

When individual times are unknown but pair sums are given, rearrange the worked days to form known pairs. Example: 5A + 10B = 5(A + B) + 5B.

Pipes & Cisterns

Follows the exact same LCM logic as Time & Work. Filling pipes have positive efficiency, while emptying (leakage) pipes have negative efficiency.
